title: Bug: pnpm install fails due to unexpected '--ignore-scripts=false' in .agents/setup
body: Running `pnpm install` via `.agents/setup` fails with the error `error: unexpected value 'false' for '--ignore-scripts' found; no more were expected`. The `install_dependencies` function includes `--ignore-scripts=false` which is not a valid value for the current pnpm version (v12.1.0). It should be changed to `--ignore-scripts` or removed.
